documents.title: Reset an account password
documents.body: Verify the recovery email, request a reset link, and invalidate older browser sessions.

documents.title: Enroll a security key
documents.body: Open security settings, register the hardware key, and confirm the recovery code.

documents.title: Export monthly invoices
documents.body: Choose the billing month, generate the invoice archive, and verify every PDF checksum.

documents.title: Configure webhook retries
documents.body: Set exponential retry intervals and review delivery receipts for failed webhook requests.

documents.title: Rotate an API token
documents.body: Create a replacement token, deploy it to clients, then revoke the previous credential.

documents.title: Restore an archived workspace
documents.body: Select the archive snapshot and restore members, projects, and access policies.

documents.title: Review audit events
documents.body: Filter sign-in, role, export, and policy events by actor and timestamp.

documents.title: Set data retention
documents.body: Choose a retention window and preview records scheduled for deletion before applying it.

documents.title: Connect a custom domain
documents.body: Add the verification record, validate TLS, and activate the domain for the workspace.

documents.title: Invite project members
documents.body: Select project roles, send invitations, and review pending membership requests.

documents.title: Resolve duplicate contacts
documents.body: Compare matching fields and merge activity history into the canonical contact.

documents.title: Schedule a report
documents.body: Choose report filters, delivery recipients, timezone, and recurring schedule.

documents.title: Pause an automation
documents.body: Pause new workflow runs while allowing active steps to record their final status.

documents.title: Create a staging environment
documents.body: Clone configuration without production secrets and verify the staging health checks.

documents.title: Import customer records
documents.body: Map source columns, validate required fields, and review rejected records before commit.

documents.title: Manage notification rules
documents.body: Route incident, billing, and security notifications to the responsible teams.

documents.title: Reconcile usage totals
documents.body: Compare metered events with the daily usage statement and investigate missing intervals.

documents.title: Configure single sign-on
documents.body: Upload identity metadata, map groups, and test login before enforcing SSO.

documents.title: Download a compliance report
documents.body: Request the signed report package and validate its manifest after download.

documents.title: Transfer workspace ownership
documents.body: Confirm the new owner, review billing access, and record the ownership transfer.

documents.title: Recover deleted projects
documents.body: Locate the recovery snapshot and restore project tasks, attachments, and history.

documents.title: Set regional storage
documents.body: Select the approved data region and validate migration readiness for current datasets.

documents.title: Create a service account
documents.body: Assign minimum roles, create a scoped credential, and record its expiration date.

documents.title: Troubleshoot delayed email
documents.body: Inspect delivery state, domain reputation, suppression lists, and recipient routing.

documents.title: Verify backup completion
documents.body: Review backup checkpoints and compare the stored object count with the source inventory.

documents.title: Update tax information
documents.body: Submit the legal address and registration number before regenerating future invoices.

documents.title: Apply an IP allowlist
documents.body: Add office and service ranges, test access, and then enforce the workspace policy.

documents.title: Inspect integration health
documents.body: Review token expiry, synchronization lag, recent errors, and the next scheduled run.

documents.title: Publish a dashboard
documents.body: Validate each chart query and grant the intended audience view-only dashboard access.

documents.title: Configure approval steps
documents.body: Define reviewers, escalation timeouts, and fallback owners for sensitive requests.

documents.title: Archive inactive teams
documents.body: Export the team roster and transfer owned resources before archiving the team.

documents.title: Validate a release note
documents.body: Check linked issues, customer impact, rollout dates, and support references before publication.
